title: Gate idle process spawns: fail `bench-soak` when an idle minute starts any subprocess
description:
## Why

Two steady-state idle leaks in one week had the same shape, and both passed every gate:

* THE-706 (first version): `git worktree list` once per registered repo root on every 5 s hydration tick (~96/min on an 8-repo registry), plus ssh/provider execs for remote rows. Caught only by an adversarial review.
* THE-716: `podman ps` + `docker ps` every 5 s, unconditionally, plus a forced loop wake — 24 spawns/min. Found only by sampling a live instance by hand.

Nothing in the repo measures how many processes an idle thegn starts. `just bench-soak` (`test/perf/cpu-sample.sh --scenario soak`, from the THE-702 work) already fails on fixed ceilings for unreaped children, zombies, fds, threads and read-syscall rate — but those catch leaks, not churn. A process spawned and correctly reaped 24 times a minute is invisible to it.

## What to build

Add a spawn-rate axis to the soak scenarios (`soak` and `soak-daemon`) with a FIXED ceiling, never baseline-derived (same doctrine as the existing ceilings — a regressed baseline must not raise the bar):

* After the existing adaptive settle, count every `execve` by the thegn process tree for a fixed idle window (e.g. 60 s), and fail if it exceeds the ceiling. The target is 0; allow a small, named, reasoned allowance only if something genuinely must run (document each).
* Report the offenders per command (argv[0] + first args) with counts, so a failure names its cause (e.g. `podman ps --format json x11`).
* Cover both the TUI and the daemon (`soak-daemon`).

Mechanism — prefer exact over sampled. The harness launches thegn itself, so it is the tracer's ancestor and `ptrace_scope=1` permits tracing it: `strace -f -qq --seccomp-bpf -e trace=execve -o <file>` counts every exec precisely with low overhead. A 20 ms `/proc` poll is a lower bound and can miss short-lived children; use it only as a fallback, and say so in the output. If strace is not in the dev shell, add it to `flake.nix`'s devShell.

## Sequencing

`main` currently FAILS this gate because of THE-716 (24 OCI spawns/min) and possibly the unverified `gh` calls (~11/min). Land THE-716 first or together. Do NOT seed an allowlist with today's debt to make the gate pass.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `just bench-soak` and `just bench-soak-daemon` fail when an idle window starts more processes than the fixed ceiling, and print the offending command lines with counts.
- [ ] Proven to fail: run it against a build that reintroduces a per-tick spawn (e.g. a temporary patch that spawns `true` on the idle ticker) and show the failure; then show it passing on the fixed tree.
- [ ] The ceiling is a constant in the script with a comment explaining it, not derived from a measured baseline.
- [ ] CLAUDE.md's perf-suite section mentions the new axis next to the zombie/fd/thread/syscall ones.
